versions.changelog:
Initial release of alltoken-call: adds slash-command style AllToken API calls via Python stdlib scripts.

- Recognizes six commands: /alltoken-chat, /alltoken-image, /alltoken-video, /alltoken-search, /alltoken-models, /alltoken-cost.
- Runs commands directly from chat using simple recipes; no external SDK required.
- Requires `ALLTOKEN_API_KEY` in the environment and Python 3.10+.
- Handles prompts flexibly with case-insensitive trigger matching.
- Enforces AllToken API constraints and provides clear error reporting.
- Designed to complement, not conflict with, the main alltoken skill.
